title: Act: Extend RenderHandle and SceneObject with hover, label and click
summary: Add pointer interaction to the entity
description: Extend RenderSpriteSpec and RenderHandle, and add hover state, last-synced state and an interact listener to SceneObject.
acceptance_criteria: RenderHandle exposes setHighlighted, setLabelVisible, onHover, onClick
SceneObject.onInteract registers a listener fired on visible clicks

steps.action: Add optional label?: string and bounds?: {x:number;y:number;width:number;height:number} to RenderSpriteSpec; add to RenderHandle: setHighlighted(on: boolean): void; setLabelVisible(on: boolean): void; onHover(cb: (over: boolean) => void): void; onClick(cb: () => void): void
steps.code: RenderHandle { setVisible; destroy; setHighlighted(on: boolean): void; setLabelVisible(on: boolean): void; onHover(cb: (over: boolean) => void): void; onClick(cb: () => void): void }
steps.expected: Interfaces compile with the new members

steps.action: Pass label: spec.name and bounds: spec.interactionBounds in the createSprite argument; then register this.handle.onHover(over => { if (!this.visible) return; this.handle.setHighlighted(over); this.handle.setLabelVisible(over); }) and this.handle.onClick(() => this.activate())
steps.expected: Hover and click wired at construction

steps.action: Add private visible = true, private lastState?: GameState and private listener?: (e:{objectId:string; actions:ActionSpec[]}) => void; sync stores state, sets visible = evaluateAll(...), calls setVisible(visible) and, when hidden, setHighlighted(false) and setLabelVisible(false); add onInteract(cb) setting the listener; add activate(): when visible and lastState defined, call listener with {objectId: spec.id, actions: availableActions(lastState, spec)}
steps.expected: Visible clicks emit, hidden clicks do not
